packet_meta.purpose: Full session memory packet — paste into new conversation to continue
packet_meta.instruction: Paste this JSON and say: 'Load this ACTP session packet and continue from where we left off.'

project.name: AI Context Transfer Protocol (ACTP)
project.stage: CLI v0.1 complete, BENCH-001 complete, BENCH-002 complete, next: Maestro

core_concept.definition: Portable AI context packets that transfer full project understanding between different AI models without re-explaining.
core_concept.analogy: Git for AI memory — versioned, portable, model-agnostic

validated_decisions.decision: Open standard free, Compressor SaaS paid — Git+GitHub model
MCP = transport layer, ACTP = payload layer
ACTP spec (data layer) and ACTP-N (network layer) separate specs
Sync is event-driven: session end / major decision / manual / scheduled
Conflict resolution: branch-both + vector clocks. P0 tie = human-in-the-loop. No silent auto-merge.
Dead letter context: un-rehydratable packets quarantined, not discarded
Format C (ACTP symbolic) is recommended default encoding — produces best code architecture and strongest mirror effect
Constraint following is determined by constraint quality, not format. Explicit anti-patterns fix model violations. Output validation still required as safety net.
Anti-pattern lists in constraints are required for reliable constraint following. Forbidden patterns must be named explicitly with provider attribution.
validated_decisions.source: BENCH-002 — Gemini 0/4 → 4/4 after explicit anti-patterns added

validated_decisions.decision: ACTP symbolic format (Format C) produces strongest mirror effect — models internalize ACTP as native protocol, not external constraint.
validated_decisions.source: BENCH-001 + BENCH-002 — all 3 models, Format C most consistent

BENCH-001.constraint_tested: ACTP must be model-agnostic — no provider SDK
BENCH-001.key_finding: Gemini hardcoded OpenAI response shape in all formats. Format alone cannot fix model violations.

key_findings: Gemini internalized ACTP as native protocol — actp_request, actp_payload, actp_intent, X-ACTP-Version, Protocol Violation
Mirror effect confirmed across all 3 models in Format C
Format D produces most defensive code — error handling + gateway architecture

files: README.md — full spec, symbolic layer, node architecture, MCP integration, roadmap, benchmarks

node_architecture.conflict_resolution: branch-both + vector clocks, P0 tie = human-in-the-loop

storage_architecture.philosophy: Bring Your Own Storage — ACTP is format + protocol, not storage
tiers: Git: commit packet to project repo after each session
SaaS: actp push / actp pull via Compressor service

next_steps.detail: Python/Node script that sends to Claude+ChatGPT+Gemini simultaneously, shows responses side by side, auto-updates ACTP packet

proof_of_concept.summary: BENCH-001 + BENCH-002 complete. 3 models × 7 formats = 21 tests total. All models pass with correct constraint quality. README + benchmarks documented.
proof_of_concept.verdict: Core concept validated. CLI works. Benchmarks complete. Maestro next.
